summary: NeuralSpeak's Free plan is $0/month with 500 NST (NeuralSpeak Tokens) included — roughly 40 minutes of voice or about 1,000 text exchanges — plus 1 service and 2 API keys, with STT/LLM/TTS orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, and analytics. No credit card required.
claim_steps: Sign up for the Free plan at neuralspeak.ai (/register or 'Start free').
No credit card stated for the Free plan; once signed in, create a service and get API keys from the dashboard.
